**Important Note:**
This competition is a twin competition alongside [Marrickville Autumn Saturday 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleAutumnSaturday2021). Competitors are permitted to attend **ONLY ONE of these competitions**. More information can be found on the Information tab.

Please also read the Information tab carefully to make sure you understand the COVID-safe requirements. Guests are limited to strictly one per competitor.
